principle: standardize over supported predictor cells rather than weighting by the number of rows contributed by a sampling universe

H_T_primary.surface: unique observed universe_id x module_opportunity2 cells in the final licensed U2+U6 assembly
H_T_primary.weighting: equal weight per supported universe x module cell
H_T_primary.counterfactual: hold universe and module fixed within each supported cell and replace temporal exposure with ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING versus SIMULTANEOUS
H_T_primary.extrapolation_ceiling: no new universe x module combination is created

H_M_U2.surface: temporal_exposure3 levels observed in final licensed U2 rows
H_M_U2.weighting: equal weight per supported U2 temporal level
H_M_U2.counterfactual: hold U2 universe and temporal level fixed and replace module opportunity with MODULAR versus SINGLE
H_M_U2.extrapolation_ceiling: no timing level absent from U2 is introduced

H_T_cross_universe.estimand: universe-specific ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING minus SIMULTANEOUS probability contrast for NONSTRUCTURAL_SEPARATION
H_T_cross_universe.surface: module_opportunity2 strata passing the frozen common-support gate
H_T_cross_universe.common_support_gate: each retained module stratum has >=2 independent SIMULTANEOUS and >=2 ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING dependence blocks in each U2 and U6
H_T_cross_universe.weighting: equal weight per retained common-support module stratum within each universe
H_T_cross_universe.counterfactual: hold universe and common-support module stratum fixed and replace temporal exposure with ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING versus SIMULTANEOUS
H_T_cross_universe.claim_rule: if no module stratum passes the common-support gate, the cross-universe contrast is not computed

posterior_reporting.direction_probability: P(Delta > 0 | data) is the fraction of posterior contrast draws strictly greater than zero
posterior_reporting.reverse_direction_probability: P(Delta < 0 | data) is the fraction strictly less than zero
posterior_reporting.registered_prior_rule: direction labels use both common-slope priors Normal(0,0.75) and Normal(0,1.5); the U6 x ORDERED interaction prior remains Normal(0,0.75)

prohibitions: do not weight pooled H_T by raw universe sample size
do not add unsupported universe x module cells to the primary standardization surface
do not compute cross-universe H_T outside module strata that pass the frozen common-support gate
do not choose a standardization surface after inspecting architecture outcomes or fitted effect signs
